name: h6
title: Chinese H-6K is intercepted off Alaska (USA) by CF-18A, F-16C and F-35A, 24 July 2024 (240724-F-D0430-1002).JPG
author: U.S. Department of Defense Photo
notes: One of the two PLAAF Xi'an H-6K bombers intercepted in the Alaska ADIZ on 24 July 2024, the cold-open event (USAF ID 240724-F-D0430-1002, same NORAD release as tu95; DVIDS 8549615; Commons tag PD US Military). The H-6K (tail number 20013, PLAAF star-and-bar, red diamond marking) flies above a CF-18A, an F-35A and an F-16C. Original 5472x3648 (kept as assets-src/tmp-air/orig/h6_1002.jpg) cropped to the bomber only, box 1100,1330,3680,2250 (2580x920, no downscale; the fighters below start ~100 px under the crop) = photos/h6.jpg. Left side view, nose left, whole aircraft incl. tail, tailplane, both wing pylons; plain overcast grey sky. Canva remove-background + layer design exported as transparent lossless PNG 2580x920 (pro); final = Canva alpha + photo RGB (scripts/alpha_cutout.py: 1 component, no specks, no holes), subject bbox 2267x618. Sticker 1369x429. Checked at 620 px wide over the grid at 1x and 2x: complete, no leftover sky, markings identical to the photo.
